links.comparator_used: ChatGPT without context (training knowledge alone), before exposure to the 412 articles
links.outcome: Concordance of recommended bariatric surgery technique with actual clinical decisions (percentage agreement and Cohen's Kappa)
links.effect: Concordance 20.0% (Kappa = 0.003; p = 0.96) without context vs 25.8% (Kappa = 0.068; p = 0.29) after exposure to the articles; significant shift in the distribution of recommended procedures (p < 0.00001). SG recommendations fell from 56.8% to 35.7%, RYGB rose from 26.8% to 30.3%, SADI-S emerged at 17.1%, and dual options appeared in 4%.
links.quote: Concordance improved modestly to 25.8 % (Kappa = 0.068; p = 0.29), with a significant shift in global distribution (p < 0.00001).
